project_type: Greenfield Next.js 15 App Router PWA, 100% client-side (no backend, no auth, no network for data). Mobile-first iOS-style phone-width column. Installable + offline via Serwist.
language: TypeScript (strict mode), React 19, JSX/TSX. All user-facing copy in Indonesian, casual Gojek-style voice.
build_system: npm. next build (wrapped by @serwist/next, which compiles src/app/sw.ts -> public/sw.js). Serwist is DISABLED in dev and ENABLED on build/start, so offline/installable behavior is only verifiable from `npm run build`, not `npm run dev`. Tailwind v4 is configured CSS-first in globals.css via @tailwindcss/postcss (no tailwind.config.js). tsconfig lib must include 'webworker' for sw.ts under strict. @/* path alias maps to src/*.
test_framework: Vitest (node environment, no DOM needed for the pure-lib suites). Tests live in src/lib/__tests__/*.test.ts. Scripts: test = 'vitest run', test:watch = 'vitest'. Integration/DOM/IndexedDB flows are manual smoke checks documented in README; automated coverage is the pure src/lib modules + the build gate.
verification_instructions: Primary gate (NFR1/AC1): fresh `npm install` then `npm run build` completes with zero TypeScript errors and no build-breaking lint under TS strict. Then `npm run test` passes all Vitest suites including the no-emoji scan. Then the constraint sweep: emoji grep over src + README returns nothing (AC19); `grep -rn lucide src` returns nothing and `grep -rn react-icons/ src` shows only react-icons/io5 (AC20). During development, `npx tsc --noEmit` is a fast incremental check between items. Each FEAT runs the build/tests it needs; FEATs that only add pure libs can use `npx tsc --noEmit` + targeted `npx vitest run <path>` and defer the full `npm run build` to a FEAT that has the app routes present.
snapshot_or_generated_files: public/sw.js is generated by @serwist/next during `npm run build` (not hand-written; src/app/sw.ts is the source). public/icons/*.png (icon-192, icon-512, maskable-512, apple-touch-icon-180) are brand placeholder PNGs produced by a small generator script or committed as valid PNGs; they must be valid so the manifest/install prompt works.
environment_constraints: Build happens directly in the workspace /private/var/www/html/heula (NO worktree). No git repo initialized yet. ABSOLUTE: zero emoji in any string anywhere (UI, copy, labels, toasts, notifications, seed data, logo); icons ONLY from react-icons/io5 (no lucide-react, no other react-icons subset). Dependencies pinned exactly (no ^). dexie and dexie-react-hooks must move together. Framer Motion imports from 'motion/react' (the 'motion' package). src/db/* and dexie/dexie-react-hooks may be imported ONLY from "use client" modules (ESLint-enforced).
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/.kiro steering exists. The three .agents/tasks docs are the authoritative spec: build strictly to design.md architecture, folder layout, method catalog, decision table R1-R16, timer/stage math, Zustand store shape, Dexie schema, Serwist wiring. Do NOT re-litigate the design. Resolve the two open MEDIUM findings from design-review.md in code (see FEAT-002 and FEAT-004).
key_patterns: Pure framework-free domain logic in src/lib (recommendation, timer, stages, stats, time, notifications) — strongly typed, no I/O, no Date.now() inside pure fns (now is injected). IconKey enum lives in src/types (NOT components) so lib stays decoupled; src/components/ui/Icon.tsx is the single io5 import choke point with `ICONS satisfies Record<IconKey, IconType>`. All copy centralized in src/lib/copy.ts (single-file no-emoji audit surface) + GOAL_LABELS: Record<Goal,string>. recommendMethod uses an early heavy guard + switch(goal) closed by `const _exhaustive: never = answers.goal`. Zustand persist key 'heula-store', partialize whitelist excludes the hydrated flag. Dexie top-level singleton, client-only. Theme anti-flash inline script in layout.tsx parses heula-store -> state.theme.
relevant_files: .agents/tasks/design-review.md (the 2 MEDIUM + 2 NIT findings to resolve in code)
src/lib/recommendation.ts (pure engine + decision table, Section 6 — Finding 1 here)
src/features/onboarding/* (Section 14 — Finding 2 filter here), src/features/timer/* (Section 15), src/features/history/*, src/features/stats/*, src/features/settings/*
directory_structure: src/app (routes: page.tsx Home, onboarding/, history/, stats/, profile/, offline/, layout.tsx, globals.css, manifest.ts, sw.ts). src/components/ui (Card, Button, Sheet, Segmented, Stepper, ConfirmDialog, Toast+ToastProvider, Icon, EmptyState, Spinner) + src/components/layout (AppShell, BottomTabBar, ThemeProvider). src/features (onboarding, timer, history, stats, settings). src/lib (methods, recommendation, timer, stages, stats, time, notifications, copy, cn + __tests__). src/store (useAppStore, types). src/db (db, sessions). src/types (index). public/icons. Root config: package.json, tsconfig.json, next.config.ts, postcss.config.mjs, eslint.config.mjs, vitest.config.ts, .gitignore, README.md.
